description: Overlay 5 of 6 in the S3 Spine sequence. Projects all prior overlay signals — structural, drift, coherence, and substrate — across the 12 IPD dimensional axes, computing 66 pairwise resonance coefficients. Produces the Dimensional Resonance Map (DRM), identifying resonance zones (signal amplification) and interference zones (signal cancellation). Requires all four preceding overlays to be complete before initializing.
role: Multi-axis signal projector — maps the full overlay stack across 66 IPD-12 pairwise resonance coefficients; produces the Dimensional Resonance Map (DRM) for the Domain Overlay
purpose: Overlay 5/6: scans all 12 IPD dimensions for resonance between overlay signals; produces Dimensional Resonance Map (DRM) with 66 pairwise coefficients; flags resonance and interference zones
